title: Predicting and forecasting influenza
summary: A complete BioLang companion to BDSR chapter 10: H7N9 exploration and feature extraction, reproducible bootstrap comparison of four classifiers, unknown-outcome prediction, and five-year CDC influenza forecasts.

source.title: Stephen D. Turner, Ph.D. — Biological Data Science with R: Predictive Analytics
source.note: Independent OriClabs BioLang companion under MIT. It follows the public section and exercise order but uses newly written explanations, BioLang code, independent Rust algorithms, and BioLang-rendered figures. Dataset files retain their separate upstream terms. This is not an official BDSR publication or endorsement.
